what_works: Hero headline anchors the founder's authority directly: 'A footwear revolution, led by a woman who knows.' Behind-the-scenes founder-at-work photography (not styled portraits) supplies the credibility the headline asserts.
what_does_not_translate: Designer-product-on-neutral-background grids are e-commerce specific; lift the founder-authority headline pattern and candid documentation, drop the product grid.
type_observations: Contemporary sans-serif at editorial scale; hierarchy entirely from size variation, never from color or weight tricks.
